name: AI UI Style Vault Section Recipe Library
purpose: Composable section-level design recipes. These are decision patterns, not templates to clone.
selectionRule: Choose recipes by page purpose, domain, conversion, evidence and content density. Do not repeat the same composition rhythm across a page without a documented reason.

recipes.composition: Specific offer and audience left; compact proof and one primary action adjacent; subject-specific media supports rather than replaces the message.
Editorial copy block and high-quality subject media share the first viewport with asymmetric balance and restrained support copy.
Outcome statement beside or above a truthful product workflow frame; primary action remains visible while the product itself proves the claim.
Full-bleed owned/licensed media with minimal DOM copy, clear controls and a static fallback; motion never contains essential text.
Credentials, licences, memberships or practitioner expertise are grouped by decision relevance rather than logo quantity.
Verified outcomes or case evidence pair with the problem context and method; metrics include source and scope.
Show the real craft, treatment, service or delivery process with concise captions that explain why it matters.
avoid: finished-product image pretending to prove process

recipes.composition: A small set of verified reviews or customer signals appears with source/context and links where permitted.
Scannable service index with client-fit cues and direct paths to detail; visual hierarchy replaces repeated card prose.
Help users self-select by need, stage or problem, then reveal the relevant service/product path.
Comparable offers use aligned attributes and meaningful differences; unavailable or unknown values are explicit.
Group capabilities around concrete customer problems and outcomes rather than internal department structure.
Varied image rhythm with intentional crops and captions; viewer preserves provenance and full subject visibility.
Filter by meaningful customer category; preserve keyboard access, result counts, empty states and stable layout.
A compact sequence of case examples foregrounds context, work and verified result rather than large decorative thumbnails.
One primary media stage with accessible thumbnails or chapters lets users inspect the subject without motion pressure.
A short numbered sequence explains the actual engagement/order journey and where customer input is required.
Milestones represent real project/product stages, dependencies and decision points; status language is explicit.
Explain what happens before, during and after consultation/fitting/advisory with privacy and preparation cues.
A truthful mini-workflow demonstrates cause and effect with static fallback and labelled prototype boundaries.
Comparable tiers/rates expose included scope, exclusions, billing basis and next action.
Use verified starting guidance with variables that change final price; direct users to quote/availability.
Explain what determines scope and fee before a specific enquiry CTA; do not disguise absence of price with filler.
Dense comparison is horizontally resilient, keyboard readable and explicit about unavailable/conditional features.
People are organized by expertise and customer relevance; credentials are verified and profile depth is progressive.
Compact roster prioritises role and relevance, with detail available on demand rather than large biography cards.
avoid: equal giant portraits for every role

recipes.composition: Founder story is concise, evidence-based and tied to product/service philosophy rather than generic origin mythology.
Directory supports filtering by discipline/location with accessible result states and direct contact only when approved.
Group real questions by decision stage; accordion is semantic and content remains accessible without JavaScript.
Questions resolve high-friction decisions such as eligibility, preparation, policy, availability or scope before conversion.
Place concise answers beside the relevant product/service decision rather than building a generic FAQ dump.
FAQ ends with a clear escalation path to verified support/contact channels and service hours when known.
One decisive conversion action repeats with context-specific copy and one optional secondary path.
Present approved contact channels by purpose; explain expected response or booking behaviour only when verified.
Location, practical access information and booking/viewing action appear together with map fallback.
Primary product action is paired with the minimum trust/reassurance needed at that decision point.
Utility navigation, verified legal/company information, contact and trust links are structured for scanning.
Location, hours if verified, contact and primary local action are immediately accessible.
Product, documentation, security, status, support and company links are grouped by user task.
Minimal verified contact/legal information preserves the editorial finish without hiding essential details.
